light_check_selection_algorithm: always include light_check_always_required_topics first; fill remaining slots deterministically from sorted(set(check_required_challenge_topics) - always_required) using sha256(f'{boot_head_final}:LIGHT_CHECK_TOPIC_SELECT:{i}')
